issues.issue: Whether the claimant has established his personal identity and Ukrainian citizenship
issues.applicant_position: Claimant is a Ukrainian citizen, shown by a copy of his passport.
issues.result_quote: The claimant's personal identity and status as a citizen of Ukraine is established on a balance of probabilities.

issues.issue: Whether the claimant's account of ethnic persecution as a Jew in Ukraine is credible
issues.applicant_position: Attacked, beaten and vandalised by nationalists for being Jewish; police gave no help.
issues.result_quote: The panel believes and so finds on a balance of probabilities that the claimant made the story up

issues.issue: Whether delay in claiming refugee protection and the claimant's explanation undermine subjective fear
issues.applicant_position: Told to stay two weeks in Vancouver to study before claiming; fear was genuine.
issues.result_quote: this panel finds no basis of a subjective fear in this claim

issues.issue: Whether adequate state protection is available to the claimant in Ukraine
issues.applicant_position: Made three police complaints and got no help; the authorities were unable or unwilling to protect him.
issues.result_quote: adequate state protection is available to the claimant in Ukraine, and it was available to the claimant when he resided in Ukraine

issues.issue: Whether the claimant faces a serious possibility of persecution or risk on return to Ukraine
issues.applicant_position: Cannot return; the authorities cannot protect him from nationalists.
issues.result_quote: the claimant has failed to satisfy his onus of establishing a serious possibility that he would be persecuted
